title: THE FIRE TEAM · TABATA GAUNTLET
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · 5 Tabata posts, 5 sprint legs, the belt gets faster every leg
why: Two passes of yesterday's chipper on a green day means today writes higher: five 4-minute Tabata posts, each exiting onto a 0.25 mi leg that speeds up every time. Snatch and get-up carry the bell work, Army-style bodyweight fills the gaps.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 5 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B · ankles, knees, shoulders for the snatch

items.name: Toe squats 30s · ankle rolls in the squat ×10/side

blocks.title: THE FIRE TEAM · 30 MIN · TABATA GAUNTLET
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · 5 POSTS · 5 RUN LEGS · 35 lb · 2×40 lb · 50 lb · cap 32:00
blocks.format: TABATA · each post = 8 × (20s work / 10s rest), alternate A and B every interval (4 of each) · leave the post, run the leg, walk to the next post · one clock the whole way
blocks.workRest: Every post exits onto the belt for 0.25 mi at 0%. LEG 1 @ 7.5. LEG 2 @ 8.0. LEG 3 @ 8.5. LEG 4 @ 9.0. LEG 5 @ 9.0 / 2%. Set the next leg before you start the post.

items.name: P1 · A: Snatch 35 lb (switch hands each interval) · B: Hand-release push-up → RUN LEG 1
P2 · A: Half get-up 35 lb (switch sides each interval) · B: Mountain climber → RUN LEG 2
items.detail: get-up to the hand, back down, repeat

items.name: P3 · A: Frog jump · B: Bear crawl forward / backward → RUN LEG 3
P4 · A: Bear-hug squat 50 lb · B: Lateral ski jump → RUN LEG 4
P5 · A: Double high pull 2×40 lb · B: Squat thrust → RUN LEG 5

blocks.noteGreen: Log reps per interval on P1 snatch and P5 high pull, finish time, RPE, and whether 9.0 held on legs 4 and 5.
blocks.text: ★ TABATA — 20s all-out, 10s off, 8 intervals = 4:00 per post; count reps, every interval is a max effort. ★ HALF GET-UP — roll to the elbow, post to the hand, hips stay down, reverse. ★ FROG JUMP — deep squat, hands touch the floor, jump forward, turn at the wall. ★ BEAR-HUG SQUAT — dumbbell hugged vertical to the chest, full depth. ★ SQUAT THRUST — hands down, feet back to the top of a push-up, feet in, stand; no push-up, no jump. ★ RUN LEG — step on moving, quick feet, cadence up as the belt speeds up.

items.name: Flutter kick ×30 (15/leg)
items.detail: low back down, feet 6 in off the floor

items.name: Calf stretch on the belt edge · 30s/side
